meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: Claude 可以控制浏览器完成网页操作：打开网址、点击元素、填写表单、滚动页面、截图、提取文字信息，并把结果返回给你。
howto.when: 当你说需要打开网页、填表或截图等浏览器操作时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开该网页并保存整页截图。

say.text: 统计页面上有多少个按钮
say.note: Claude 会返回按钮数量的数字。

say.text: 在搜索框填“天气”然后点搜索按钮
say.note: Claude 会填入文字并点击。

howto.what_en: Claude can control a browser to open pages, click elements, fill forms, scroll, take screenshots, and extract text, then report results to you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for browser tasks such as opening a webpage, filling a form, taking a screenshot, or extracting page information.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and saves a full-page screenshot.

say_en.text: Count how many buttons are on this page.
say_en.note: Claude returns the number of buttons.

say_en.text: Fill 'weather' in the search box and click search.
say_en.note: Claude types the text and clicks the button.
